items.title: Cripple a Mirelurk's Limb
items.detail: Fast travel to Spruce Knob Lake and cripple a Mirelurk's Limb by aiming at the Limb with a rifle. Using V.A.T.S. makes this easier.

items.title: Collect a Teddy Bear
items.detail: Northeast of Knife Edge in a half-destroyed shack are several Teddy Bears up on a ledge. Toss a grenade onto the ledge in order to knock them down.

items.title: Cripple a Ghoul's Leg
items.detail: Fast travel to The Whitespring Golf Club on the grounds of the Whitespring and cripple a Ghoul's Leg by aiming at the Leg with a rifle. Using V.A.T.S. makes this easier.

items.title: Collect a can of Cajun Rice & Beans
Eat a can of Cajun Rice & Beans
Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during a Daily Operation!
Sell a Sweet Roll to an NPC vendor
Build a Decoration in a Shelter
items.detail: Enter the Shelter at your C.A.M.P. Access the build menu (press "Q" on PC) and select the "Decorations" category. Place any decoration such as a small balloon or clutter that requires minimal resources.

items.title: Catch a Fish
items.detail: Fast travel to Fisherman's Rest and start the 'Big Fish in a Small Pond' daily so the same catch credits both challenges. Fisherman's Rest sits east of Valley Galleria in The Mire region.

items.title: Collect RadAway or Rad-X
items.detail: Collect RadAway or Rad-X from world loot, containers, or vendors to credit the challenge. A quick option if you have any RadAway or Rad-X in your stash is to craft the diluted forms at a chemistry station with Purified Water.

items.title: Collect Soap
items.detail: If your C.A.M.P. has a Whitespring Robo Butler Collectron station, collect the Soap it produces passively. A reliable option is to fast travel to The Whitespring Resort and go behind the main building to the red brick building.

items.title: Collect a Board Game
items.detail: If your C.A.M.P. has a Games Cupboard, take a Board Game from it directly; it produces Blast Radius, Autopsy, Catch the Commie, Rad Poker, and Unstoppables! board games.

items.title: Eat a Vegetable
items.detail: Eating any raw vegetable credits this daily. Harvest Tato, Corn, or Razorgrain from your C.A.M.P. or from Billings Homestead, then eat one.
